summary: A full structure response went to the 800 block of Piute Street for a gas leak inside a home, with a fire detector sounding.
A rescue crew was sent outside the rescue mission in the 800 block of East 21st Street for a person close to fainting.
A pedestrian, an adult woman, was reported hurt in the 1700 block of South Chester Avenue near a gas station. Her boyfriend took her for care in a private vehicle and the ambulance was not needed.
A crew was sent to a furniture store in the 1600 block of South Chester Avenue for an ill patient.
Officers were sent to the 9500 block of Lake Superior Drive for a 10-year-old reported to be making suicidal statements.
A crew was sent to an apartment in the 3100 block of South 8th Street for a patient with abdominal pain.

disposition: balance canceled; two companies handled it
summary: Crews found light smoke coming from the attic of a home with no visible flame, and the balance of the assignment was canceled.

A person listed as at risk left a home in the 2600 block of Cherry Street on foot at about 6 p.m. after a disturbance, saying he wanted to die. He was last seen in a burgundy or black sweatshirt and dark shoes.

disposition: crew on standby; possible major injuries
summary: A motorcyclist hit a deer on Kernville Road. There was a single patient whose condition was not known, and the injuries were reported as possibly major.
A train was reported stopped across Edison Highway at Morning Drive, with railroad security already with the train.
Officers were sent to the 2500 block of Eve Street for a suicidal subject.

A car was reported on its side on Highway 178 west of Highway 14, near Walker Pass, at 8:34 p.m. with a woman out of the vehicle. An ambulance was advised that three patients would be transported, and a crew staged at the summit.
A crew was sent to the 7800 block of Kelwona Way for an unresponsive patient who had overdosed.
Officers found a 67-year-old man who had possibly overdosed, conscious, in front of a business on Chester Avenue.
A man with a burn was already being treated when a crew was sent to the 2200 block of Virginia Avenue.

disposition: officers sent; history at the address
summary: Officers were sent to an apartment in the 9200 block of California Avenue for a domestic disturbance, with two juveniles in the residence and a history of domestic violence at the address.
Officers checked on a suicidal person in the 3700 block of Quicksilver Drive.
Officers circled a store in the 500 block of Bohannan Avenue for a man in a gray shirt and blue jeans, 25 to 30 years old, reported to be making threats to customers.
A woman in a wheelchair was reported putting herself behind cars to be hit and refusing to leave the roadway.

disposition: full response; no smoke or flames
summary: A full structure response went to the 200 block of Hazelwood Avenue for an electrical smell inside a home, with no smoke or flames showing.
A crew was sent to a medical call at the Plaza Towers in the 3000 block of Wilson Road.
An automatic fire alarm came in for the Plaza Towers in the 3000 block of Wilson Road, and the caller hung up after saying he needed to go.
Officers found the subject of a call at an apartment complex in the 2300 block of 17th Street, looking at windows.
Officers were sent to the 12000 block of El Capitan Avenue for a suicidal subject.
A 911 hang-up at 1st and Tyler streets brought officers to the area. Voices were heard at a distance and no one answered a callback.
Three juveniles told dispatchers their mother had left them home alone, in the 1000 block of Washington Street.
A caller asked officers to check on a man in the 900 block of Olive Drive.
A crew was sent to the 1000 block of Purdue Drive for a medical call.
A woman who called 911 and disconnected was reported to be trying to kill herself, then disconnected a second time.
A crew was sent to Sunrise Apartments for a diabetic problem.
A crew went to the Navigation Center in the 1900 block of East Brundage Lane for a man refusing to leave the front of the building.
Crews made entry at a residence and found the occupant asleep. The ambulance was canceled.
Officers were sent to the 5000 block of Pierce Road for a domestic violence call. The man left on a red and black scooter.
A woman in the 400 block of Goodman Street heard footsteps in her backyard and had no visual on anyone. She was armed with a hammer.
A small amount of smoke was coming from the outside of a trailer, and one company was able to handle it.
A crew was sent for a stroke patient.
A crew was sent to a mobile home park for a traumatic injury.

disposition: fire knocked down; units on scene handled it
summary: A tractor-trailer's rear tires caught fire on Highway 99 just before 11:49 p.m. The tractor was pulled off the trailer, and the fire was knocked down two minutes later.
CHP asked for units to look for a man in a dark blue Tahoe and a motorcycle near Collison Street.
CHP was working an object in the roadway on southbound Highway 99 at Airport Drive and asked how to divert traffic.
A crew was sent to the 8400 block of Jackson Street for a traumatic injury.

disposition: correction to the location; crews sent
summary: Two small fires were reported along the railroad tracks just east of Edison Highway and Mount Vernon Avenue, and the location was corrected to Edison Highway and Chamberlain Avenue.
A crew was sent to Shafter Senior Manor on State Avenue for an ill patient.
A traffic stop just after 1 a.m. turned up a large amount of narcotics in a vehicle, and a sergeant was called out.
A crew was sent to the 100 block of Majestic Sky Court in Ridgecrest for a patient not breathing after a seizure, with police arriving first.
A rescue crew was sent to Dolores Street for a 911 hang-up handled as a medical call.
A crew was sent to the Lake Isabella RV Resort on Highway 178 for a patient with difficulty breathing.
Officers were sent to a residence on Wainwright Drive for a woman in her late 30s known to carry a knife who was trying to climb through a window.

disposition: Battalion 1 command; ventilation requested; utilities and gas company notified
summary: Crews found heavy fire from the rear of a structure and could not reach it with an attack line. Battalion 1 took command, a truck was asked for ventilation, and building utilities and the gas company were notified.
A crew was sent to California Avenue Senior Housing in the 1100 block of California Avenue for a psych patient, with a city unit on scene and fire needed to get in.
A crew was sent outside the 2300 block of 16th Street for chest pain.
A company was sent to the 5700 block of Thorner Street for an oxide alarm.

disposition: driver and passenger detained; vehicle cleared
summary: Officers behind a maroon Mercedes four-door saw it crash on Brundage just after 4:09 a.m. The driver and the passenger were detained and the car was cleared for tow.
A crew was sent to the front of a business in the 2300 block of South Union Avenue for a medical call.
A crew was sent to the 100 block of Oildale Drive for a patient with difficulty breathing.
A crew was sent inside a business in the 2200 block of Niles Street.

disposition: under 5 gallons; contained to the pump; mitigated
summary: A hazmat crew was sent to a truck stop for a diesel leak from a fuel pump. On arrival less than 5 gallons had spilled, it was contained to the pump, and it was cleaned up.
A medical alarm company reported that someone at an address had fallen and could not get up, and crews confirmed help was needed and worked to get in.
Traffic crash at Circle K on Auburn Street.
Person with bleeding injury near Scott Place, Bakersfield.
Man attempts stabbing near Wible Road in Bakersfield.
